gates.name: npm run lint
gates.reason: eslint . fails for two independent reasons, and only one of them is environmental. (1) 'No tsconfigRootDir was set, and multiple candidate TSConfigRootDirs are present' parsing errors naming this repo root and .claude/worktrees/inspiring-jemison-f70809 as the two candidates — that worktree is a separate, concurrently running background session (the spawned inferRepository fix, PR #27 base) checked out under .claude/worktrees/ inside this same clone, and its own tsconfig.json is confusing typescript-eslint's project-service auto-detection. That part is a collision between two concurrent worktrees, not this branch's diff. (2) This branch's own defect: eslint's flat config ignores only node_modules by default and never reads a .gitignore, so once docs/ is built, eslint . also lints docs/build/ and docs/.docusaurus/ generated output — 22 of the 109 errors observed, plus 972 when those two directories are linted directly. Fixed on this branch by an ignores entry in eslint.config.js (and matching root .gitignore entries for prettier, whose --ignore-path likewise defaults to the root .gitignore only). Removing the other worktree alone would NOT have made this gate pass.
